paragraphs.text: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Saviour, and Christ Jesus our hope;
paragraphs.original: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ κατʼ ἐπιταγὴν θεοῦ σωτῆρος ἡμῶν καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τῆς ἐλπίδος ἡμῶν
paragraphs.translit: Paulos apostolos Christou Iēsou katʼ epitagēn theou sōtēros hēmōn kai Christou Iēsou tēs elpidos hēmōn

paragraphs.text: unto Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
paragraphs.original: Τιμοθέῳ γνησίῳ τέκνῳ ἐν πίστει· χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ θεοῦ πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: Timotheō gnēsiō teknō en pistei· charis, eleos, eirēnē apo theou patros kai Christou Iēsou tou kyriou hēmōn.

paragraphs.text: As I exhorted thee to tarry at Ephesus, when I was going into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge certain men not to teach a different doctrine,
paragraphs.original: Καθὼς παρεκάλεσά σε προσμεῖναι ἐν Ἐφέσῳ, πορευόμενος εἰς Μακεδονίαν, ἵνα παραγγείλῃς τισὶν μὴ ἑτεροδιδασκαλεῖν
paragraphs.translit: Kathōs parekalesa se prosmeinai en Ephesō, poreuomenos eis Makedonian, hina parangeilēs tisin mē heterodidaskalein

paragraphs.text: neither to give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questionings, rather than a dispensation of God which is in faith; [so do I now].
paragraphs.original: μηδὲ προσέχειν μύθοις καὶ γενεαλογίαις ἀπεράντοις, αἵτινες ἐκζητήσεις παρέχουσι μᾶλλον ἢ οἰκονομίαν θεοῦ τὴν ἐν πίστει—
paragraphs.translit: mēde prosechein mythois kai genealogiais aperantois, haitines ekzētēseis parechousi mallon ē oikonomian theou tēn en pistei—

paragraphs.text: But the end of the charge is love out of a pure heart and a good conscience and faith unfeigned:
paragraphs.original: τὸ δὲ τέλος τῆς παραγγελίας ἐστὶν ἀγάπη ἐκ καθαρᾶς καρδίας καὶ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς καὶ πίστεως ἀνυποκρίτου,
paragraphs.translit: to de telos tēs parangelias estin agapē ek katharas kardias kai syneidēseōs agathēs kai pisteōs anypokritou,

paragraphs.text: from which things some having swerved have turned aside unto vain talking;
paragraphs.original: ὧν τινες ἀστοχήσαντες ἐξετράπησαν εἰς ματαιολογίαν,
paragraphs.translit: hōn tines astochēsantes exetrapēsan eis mataiologian,

paragraphs.text: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor whereof they confidently affirm.
paragraphs.original: θέλοντες εἶναι νομοδιδάσκαλοι, μὴ νοοῦντες μήτε ἃ λέγουσιν μήτε περὶ τίνων διαβεβαιοῦνται.
paragraphs.translit: thelontes einai nomodidaskaloi, mē noountes mēte ha legousin mēte peri tinōn diabebaiountai.

paragraphs.text: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully,
paragraphs.original: Οἴδαμεν δὲ ὅτι καλὸς ὁ νόμος ἐάν τις αὐτῷ νομίμως χρῆται,
paragraphs.translit: Oidamen de hoti kalos ho nomos ean tis autō nomimōs chrētai,

paragraphs.text: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and unruly, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,
paragraphs.original: εἰδὼς τοῦτο, ὅτι δικαίῳ νόμος οὐ κεῖται, ἀνόμοις δὲ καὶ ἀνυποτάκτοις, ἀσεβέσι καὶ ἁμαρτωλοῖς, ἀνοσίοις καὶ βεβήλοις, πατρολῴαις καὶ μητρολῴαις, ἀνδροφόνοις,
paragraphs.translit: eidōs touto, hoti dikaiō nomos ou keitai, anomois de kai anypotaktois, asebesi kai hamartōlois, anosiois kai bebēlois, patrolōais kai mētrolōais, androphonois,

paragraphs.text: for fornicators, for abusers of themselves with men, for menstealers, for liars, for false swearers, and if there be any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;
paragraphs.original: πόρνοις, ἀρσενοκοίταις, ἀνδραποδισταῖς, ψεύσταις, ἐπιόρκοις, καὶ εἴ τι ἕτερον τῇ ὑγιαινούσῃ διδασκαλίᾳ ἀντίκειται,
paragraphs.translit: pornois, arsenokoitais, andrapodistais, pseustais, epiorkois, kai ei ti heteron tē hygiainousē didaskalia antikeitai,

paragraphs.text: according to the gospel of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.
paragraphs.original: κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τῆς δόξης τοῦ μακαρίου θεοῦ, ὃ ἐπιστεύθην ἐγώ.
paragraphs.translit: kata to euangelion tēs doxēs tou makariou theou, ho episteuthēn egō.

paragraphs.text: I thank him that enabled me, [even] Christ Jesus our Lord, for that he counted me faithful, appointing me to [his] service;
paragraphs.original: Χάριν ἔχω τῷ ἐνδυναμώσαντί με Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν, ὅτι πιστόν με ἡγήσατο θέμενος εἰς διακονίαν,
paragraphs.translit: Charin echō tō endynamōsanti me Christō Iēsou tō kyriō hēmōn, hoti piston me hēgēsato themenos eis diakonian,

paragraphs.text: though I was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: howbeit I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief;
paragraphs.original: τὸ πρότερον ὄντα βλάσφημον καὶ διώκτην καὶ ὑβριστήν· ἀλλὰ ἠλεήθην, ὅτι ἀγνοῶν ἐποίησα ἐν ἀπιστίᾳ,
paragraphs.translit: to proteron onta blasphēmon kai diōktēn kai hybristēn· alla ēleēthēn, hoti agnoōn epoiēsa en apistia,

paragraphs.text: and the grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
paragraphs.original: ὑπερεπλεόνασεν δὲ ἡ χάρις τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν μετὰ πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ.
paragraphs.translit: hyperepleonasen de hē charis tou kyriou hēmōn meta pisteōs kai agapēs tēs en Christō Iēsou.

paragraphs.text: Faithful is the saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief:
paragraphs.original: πιστὸς ὁ λόγος καὶ πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἄξιος, ὅτι Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς ἦλθεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἁμαρτωλοὺς σῶσαι· ὧν πρῶτός εἰμι ἐγώ,
paragraphs.translit: pistos ho logos kai pasēs apodochēs axios, hoti Christos Iēsous ēlthen eis ton kosmon hamartōlous sōsai· hōn prōtos eimi egō,

paragraphs.text: howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me as chief might Jesus Christ show forth all his longsuffering, for an ensample of them that should thereafter believe on him unto eternal life.
paragraphs.original: ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἠλεήθην, ἵνα ἐν ἐμοὶ πρώτῳ ἐνδείξηται Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς τὴν ἅπασαν μακροθυμίαν, πρὸς ὑποτύπωσιν τῶν μελλόντων πιστεύειν ἐπʼ αὐτῷ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον.
paragraphs.translit: alla dia touto ēleēthēn, hina en emoi prōtō endeixētai Christos Iēsous tēn hapasan makrothymian, pros hypotypōsin tōn mellontōn pisteuein epʼ autō eis zōēn aiōnion.

paragraphs.text: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only God, [be] honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: τῷ δὲ βασιλεῖ τῶν αἰώνων, ἀφθάρτῳ, ἀοράτῳ, μόνῳ θεῷ, τιμὴ καὶ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: tō de basilei tōn aiōnōn, aphthartō, aoratō, monō theō, timē kai doxa eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn· amēn.

paragraphs.text: This charge I commit unto thee, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to thee, that by them thou mayest war the good warfare;
paragraphs.original: Ταύτην τὴν παραγγελίαν παρατίθεμαί σοι, τέκνον Τιμόθεε, κατὰ τὰς προαγούσας ἐπὶ σὲ προφητείας, ἵνα στρατεύῃ ἐν αὐταῖς τὴν καλὴν στρατείαν,
paragraphs.translit: Tautēn tēn parangelian paratithemai soi, teknon Timothee, kata tas proagousas epi se prophēteias, hina strateuē en autais tēn kalēn strateian,

paragraphs.text: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust from them made shipwreck concerning the faith:
paragraphs.original: ἔχων πίστιν καὶ ἀγαθὴν συνείδησιν, ἥν τινες ἀπωσάμενοι περὶ τὴν πίστιν ἐναυάγησαν·
paragraphs.translit: echōn pistin kai agathēn syneidēsin, hēn tines apōsamenoi peri tēn pistin enauagēsan·

paragraphs.text: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered unto Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
paragraphs.original: ὧν ἐστιν Ὑμέναιος καὶ Ἀλέξανδρος, οὓς παρέδωκα τῷ Σατανᾷ ἵνα παιδευθῶσι μὴ βλασφημεῖν.
paragraphs.translit: hōn estin Hymenaios kai Alexandros, hous paredōka tō Satana hina paideuthōsi mē blasphēmein.
